authority: Evidence qualification only. This policy cannot authorize capital, execution, model production promotion, or Benjamin decisions.

required: complete immutable raw or compressed microstructure journal
VALID market-data quality or equivalent frozen qualification
reconstructable Z1 canonical observations and Z2 point-in-time frames
zero capital and zero external execution
excluded: captures whose raw evidence was not durably preserved
captures with material processing backlog that invalidates the configured freshness gate
candle-only datasets that cannot reconstruct the Z4 microstructure inputs

walk_forward.prerequisite: broad_historical evidence minimum must be met before scoring
walk_forward.fold_rule: Each evaluation fold contains only windows later than all competence/training windows used for that fold.
walk_forward.competence_rule: Z7 competence and Z8 weights may use only outcomes knowable before the first prediction in the evaluation fold.
walk_forward.parameter_rule: No model, horizon, weighting-policy, endpoint, or metric changes after any evaluation-fold outcome is inspected.
walk_forward.population_rule: Every resolved, unresolved, losing, null, and abstaining eligible prediction remains in its fold population.

contextual.reason: Z9 market/spot-futures context does not exist yet, so contextual adaptive-weight qualification would certify a nonexistent input layer.
